name: Koly rozkvitayutʹ prolisky
source:
What can a girl regret when her mother died in a terrible accident and her father practically lives at work?


And what can a father regret when he has lost his wife and has to work his ass off to support his daughter?


This story is about fifteen-year-old Ami and her father Vito, who cannot see each other because of their problems.

[Translated from [url=https://squidsquadpapi.itch.io/yukidaruma6]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
母亲死于一场可怕的意外，父亲几乎整天都在工作，一个女孩会为此感到什么遗憾？

妻子已经离世，还得拼命工作来养活女儿，一位父亲又会为此感到什么遗憾？

这是一个关于15岁的Ami和她父亲Vito的故事。两人各有烦恼，却因此无法彼此理解。

[来源：[url=https://squidsquadpapi.itch.io/yukidaruma6]itch.io[/url]]
